name: Sesame Beef with Broccoli, Red Pepper, Green Onion & Rice (Prep Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 3 medium food storage containers.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup jasmine rice
1 ½ cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 crown broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, trim green onions. Chop the white and pale green parts into 1-inch pieces and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Cut dark green parts crosswise into thin pieces and set aside.
Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers crosswise, then slice into thin strips. Add to the baking sheet with the green onion pieces.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the baking sheet.

Pat steak dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch pieces. Add to the baking sheet. Drizzle steak and veggies with stir-fry sauce and oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb striploin (New York strip) steak
⅓ cup stir-fry sauce
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and steak is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.

Divide rice, steak, and veggies between storage containers, and allow to cool completely, about 20 minutes. Once cool, sprinkle with reserved green onions, cover containers, and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat in the oven or microwave and enjoy!
